subject.title: Dashboard: action-form widget — buttons and forms that dispatch the agent

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled dashboard action-form widget that dispatches parameterized prompts, or require this capability to live outside core until the dashboard substrate and security contract are accepted?
rationale: This is a new prompt-dispatching dashboard surface, not a broken current behavior, and automation cannot choose the permanent product/security boundary for bundled dashboard widgets.

options.title: Defer behind substrate review
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus the prompt-dispatch security contract to be accepted before this feature lands.

options.title: Sponsor bundled builtin
options.body: Approve a first-party dashboard action-form widget and review the linked PR as security-sensitive bundled plugin work.

options.title: Move to plugin path
options.body: Decline a bundled core feature and ask for a ClawHub/plugin implementation or a narrower plugin API gap instead.

recommendation.title: Defer behind substrate review
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require the Wave 1 dashboard substrate plus the prompt-dispatch security contract to be accepted before this feature lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history for the plugin-tab and chat-dispatch surfaces points here as the strongest available maintainer-routing signal.
